genes.function: Master transcription factor driving B cell terminal differentiation into plasma cells and antibody-secreting cells
genes.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. PRDM1 risk variants alter Blimp-1 expression in B cells, dysregulating plasma cell differentiation and autoantibody production. Elevated Blimp-1+ plasma cells in SLE.
genes.recommendation: High likelihood of response to CD19 CAR-T. B-cell-dependent pathway with strong plasma cell involvement.

genes.function: Critical B cell survival and maturation factor
genes.lupus_evidence: Elevated serum BAFF levels in SLE patients. Direct therapeutic target of belimumab. Overexpression drives autoantibody production.
genes.recommendation: High likelihood of response to CD19 CAR-T. B-cell-dependent pathway with strong plasma cell involvement.

genes.function: Transcription factor regulating B cell differentiation, plasma cell development, and autoantibody production
genes.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. AIOLOS deficiency in mice leads to lupus-like disease with anti-dsDNA antibodies. Key regulator of plasma cell differentiation and humoral autoimmunity.
genes.recommendation: High likelihood of response to CD19 CAR-T. B-cell-dependent pathway with strong plasma cell involvement.

genes.function: B cell surface protein involved in B cell activation, proliferation, and calcium signaling
genes.lupus_evidence: Target of B cell depletion therapies (rituximab, obinutuzumab) used clinically in refractory SLE.
genes.recommendation: High likelihood of response to CD19 CAR-T. B-cell-dependent pathway with strong plasma cell involvement.

genes.function: Essential kinase for B cell receptor and Fc receptor signaling
genes.lupus_evidence: BTK inhibition reduces B cell activation, autoantibody production, and kidney damage in lupus models.
genes.recommendation: High likelihood of response to CD19 CAR-T. B-cell-dependent pathway with strong plasma cell involvement.

genes.function: Lineage-determining transcription factor essential for lymphocyte development; regulates B and T cell differentiation
genes.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE across multiple ancestries. IKZF1 variants alter lymphocyte development and promote autoimmunity through dysregulated B and T cell differentiation.
genes.recommendation: High likelihood of response to CD19 CAR-T. B-cell-dependent pathway with strong plasma cell involvement.

genes.function: Src family kinase involved in B cell receptor signaling
genes.lupus_evidence: Reduced BLK expression in B cells impairs tolerance checkpoints and promotes autoantibody production.
genes.recommendation: High likelihood of response to CD19 CAR-T. B-cell-dependent pathway with strong plasma cell involvement.

genes.gene_name: B Cell Scaffold Protein with Ankyrin Repeats 1
genes.function: Scaffold protein modulating B cell receptor-induced calcium mobilization
genes.lupus_evidence: Associated with SLE through variants affecting B cell hyperresponsiveness.
genes.recommendation: High likelihood of response to CD19 CAR-T. B-cell-dependent pathway with strong plasma cell involvement.

genes.function: E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme that promotes linear ubiquitination and NF-κB activation; regulates B cell and plasma cell function
genes.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE and multiple autoimmune diseases. Risk allele increases UBE2L3 expression in B cells, enhancing NF-κB activation, plasma cell differentiation, and autoantibody production.
genes.recommendation: High likelihood of response to CD19 CAR-T. B-cell-dependent pathway with strong plasma cell involvement.

genes.function: Lymphoid tyrosine phosphatase (LYP) that negatively regulates T cell receptor signaling
genes.lupus_evidence: R620W gain-of-function variant alters T cell selection thresholds and promotes autoimmunity.
genes.recommendation: Good candidate. CAR-T should address core pathway dysfunction. Consider combination with targeted therapy.

genes.function: Costimulatory molecule enhancing T cell activation and survival
genes.lupus_evidence: Upregulated in SLE; promotes T follicular helper responses and autoantibody production.
genes.recommendation: May benefit from CAR-T indirectly through B cell depletion. Monitor for non-B-cell disease activity.

genes.function: Antigen presentation to CD4+ T cells
genes.lupus_evidence: Strongest genetic association with SLE. DRB1*03:01 and *15:01 alleles confer 2-3x increased risk.
genes.recommendation: May benefit from CAR-T indirectly through B cell depletion. Monitor for non-B-cell disease activity.

genes.function: Endosomal sensor of single-stranded RNA; drives type I IFN production in plasmacytoid DCs
genes.lupus_evidence: Gene duplication and gain-of-function mutations cause lupus in mice and humans. Key driver of the IFN signature.
genes.recommendation: May benefit from CAR-T indirectly through B cell depletion. Monitor for non-B-cell disease activity.

genes.function: Endosomal sensor of unmethylated CpG DNA; activates B cells and pDCs
genes.lupus_evidence: Recognizes DNA-containing immune complexes; contributes to anti-dsDNA antibody production.
genes.recommendation: May benefit from CAR-T indirectly through B cell depletion. Monitor for non-B-cell disease activity.

genes.function: Rate-limiting enzyme in de novo guanine nucleotide synthesis; essential for lymphocyte proliferation
genes.lupus_evidence: Target of mycophenolate mofetil, a first-line therapy for lupus nephritis.
genes.recommendation: May benefit from CAR-T indirectly through B cell depletion. Monitor for non-B-cell disease activity.

genes.function: Transcription factor driving type I IFN and proinflammatory cytokine expression
genes.lupus_evidence: Key regulator of the type I interferon signature. Risk haplotype associated with high serum IFN-α activity.
genes.recommendation: May benefit from CAR-T indirectly through B cell depletion. Monitor for non-B-cell disease activity.

genes.function: Ubiquitin-editing enzyme that negatively regulates NF-κB signaling
genes.lupus_evidence: Loss-of-function variants reduce negative regulation of NF-κB, promoting chronic inflammation.
genes.recommendation: May benefit from CAR-T indirectly through B cell depletion. Monitor for non-B-cell disease activity.

genes.gene_name: Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 4
genes.function: Mediates IL-12 and type I IFN signaling; promotes Th1 and Th17 differentiation
genes.lupus_evidence: Risk variant rs7574865 associated with increased STAT4 expression and SLE susceptibility.
genes.recommendation: May benefit from CAR-T indirectly through B cell depletion. Monitor for non-B-cell disease activity.

genes.function: Universal adaptor protein for TLR7, TLR9, and IL-1 receptor family signaling; recruits IRAK4 and activates IRF5/IRF7
genes.lupus_evidence: MyD88 is essential for TLR7/TLR9-mediated B cell activation and autoantibody production. MyD88-deficient lupus-prone mice are protected from disease. A central signaling hub in the lupus IFN pathway.
genes.recommendation: May benefit from CAR-T indirectly through B cell depletion. Monitor for non-B-cell disease activity.

genes.function: Ubiquitin-binding protein that cooperates with TNFAIP3 (A20) to negatively regulate NF-κB signaling
genes.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. TNIP1 risk variants reduce expression and impair A20-mediated NF-κB suppression. TNIP1-deficient mice develop lupus-like autoimmunity.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Essential kinase downstream of MyD88 in TLR7/TLR9 and IL-1R signaling; phosphorylates IRF5 and IRF7
genes.lupus_evidence: IRAK4 is critical for TLR7/TLR9-driven IFN-α and autoantibody production in lupus models. Pharmacological IRAK4 inhibition reduces disease severity in murine lupus.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.gene_name: Interferon Alpha and Beta Receptor Subunit 1
genes.function: Receptor subunit for type I interferons (IFN-α/β)
genes.lupus_evidence: Key mediator of the interferon signature. Therapeutic target of anifrolumab.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Nuclear receptor that mediates anti-inflammatory effects via transrepression of NF-κB and AP-1, and induction of anti-inflammatory genes
genes.lupus_evidence: Target of prednisone and all corticosteroids, the mainstay of acute SLE management. Goal is to minimize exposure due to toxicity.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Janus kinase mediating type I IFN and IL-12/IL-23 signaling
genes.lupus_evidence: Protective loss-of-function variants associated with reduced SLE risk. Selective TYK2 inhibitors in development.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Master transcription factor for type I IFN production; activated downstream of TLR7/TLR9-MyD88 signaling in plasmacytoid DCs
genes.lupus_evidence: IRF7 risk variants associated with increased IFN-α production and SLE susceptibility. IRF7 is essential for the TLR7/TLR9 → IFN-α axis in pDCs. Gain-of-function variants identified in familial SLE.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Tyrosine kinase mediating signaling for type I/II cytokine receptors
genes.lupus_evidence: Required for IFN-α/β, IL-6, and other proinflammatory cytokine signaling. Target of baricitinib and tofacitinib in SLE trials.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Calcium/calmodulin-dependent serine/threonine phosphatase; dephosphorylates NFAT enabling T cell activation
genes.lupus_evidence: Target of voclosporin and tacrolimus for lupus nephritis; also stabilizes podocyte actin cytoskeleton in kidney.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Core autophagy protein essential for autophagosome formation; also involved in lymphocyte development and immune regulation
genes.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated in SLE. ATG5 polymorphisms associated with SLE susceptibility. Autophagy dysregulation impairs T and B cell homeostasis, mitochondrial clearance, and promotes type I IFN production.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Low-affinity receptor for IgG immune complexes on phagocytes
genes.lupus_evidence: H131R polymorphism alters IgG binding affinity and immune complex clearance, increasing lupus nephritis risk.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Low-affinity receptor for IgG; mediates ADCC and immune complex clearance
genes.lupus_evidence: V158F polymorphism affects IgG binding and is associated with SLE susceptibility.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Complement receptor 3 (CR3) component; mediates phagocytosis and immune complex clearance
genes.lupus_evidence: Missense variants (R77H) impair phagocytosis of apoptotic cells and immune complexes.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Involved in cytoskeletal rearrangement, cell migration, and apoptotic cell clearance
genes.lupus_evidence: GWAS-implicated specifically in lupus nephritis. ELMO1 variants associated with increased risk of renal involvement in SLE. Promotes macrophage-mediated clearance of apoptotic cells in the kidney.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Initiates classical complement pathway; opsonizes apoptotic cells for clearance by macrophages
genes.lupus_evidence: Homozygous C1q deficiency is the strongest monogenic cause of SLE (>90% penetrance). C1q opsonizes apoptotic debris; deficiency leads to accumulation of self-antigen and loss of tolerance.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Component of classical and lectin complement pathways; forms C3 convertase with C4
genes.lupus_evidence: C2 deficiency is one of the most common complement deficiencies associated with SLE (~10-20% of homozygous deficient develop SLE). Associated with anti-Ro/SSA antibodies and photosensitivity.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.

genes.function: Key component of classical complement pathway; C4A is more efficient at opsonizing immune complexes than C4B
genes.lupus_evidence: C4A copy number variation (low gene copy number) is strongly associated with SLE. Low C4A levels impair immune complex clearance and waste disposal. Gene copy number <2 confers ~3-6x risk.
genes.recommendation: Limited direct CAR-T benefit. Pathway not primarily B-cell-driven. Consider alternative therapies.
